# nostr-tools 2.7.2

The browser bundle (`nostr.bundle.js`, global `NostrTools`) of https://github.com/nbd-wtf/nostr-tools, released into the
public domain (Unlicense), from jsDelivr. Used by js/relay.js to sign the ephemeral events of the Nostr relays in the relay
list (key generation, `finalizeEvent`); loaded only when a Nostr relay is used.
